plugins.description: Lean harness-engineering plugin: four pillars (architecture guardrails, documentation as system of record, observability & legibility, entropy management) enforced as repo-local mechanical constraints. Composes with gstack (v1.46+ floor, v1.79 current; reconciles its content-addressed review verdicts read-only) for delivery — never orchestrates. Emits a versioned verify/review decision-signal Gate API (docs/SIGNALS.md) that Dynamic Workflows, Agent Teams, and the pre-ship convention check gate on; coordination ceded to the platform.
